repository_card.frontier: The finite Gaussian programme stages Wick, integration by parts, uniform moments and massive covariance decay; external analytic inputs remain explicit.
repository_card.bridge_hypothesis: Use the new concentration and regularization papers to split three obligations: finite moments, mollifier stability, and spatial decay. Dictionary: random-field overlap -> candidate scalar concentration observable; GFF regularization -> cutoff comparison. Neither mapping preserves mass or locality automatically.
repository_card.next_finite_task: On a finite massive chain, compute covariance decay and compare two smoothing kernels at fixed mass and growing size. Tabulate constants by size, mass and smoothing scale before proposing a dimension-uniform lemma.
repository_card.falsifier: Reject the bridge if constants diverge with size, if massless logarithmic correlations replace exponential decay, or if the matching field-law condition is absent.
repository_card.proposal_status: speculative; not executed or formally verified

sources.title: On overlap concentration in the Curie-Weiss Random Field model
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: A Curie-Weiss random-field result gives sub-Gaussian overlap tails under beta<1 and a specifically matched Gaussian field law, via Laplace analysis and a moment-generating-function bootstrap.
sources.limits: The field law and matching condition are part of the result. Mean-field replica overlap concentration does not yield spatial covariance decay or Yang-Mills small-field estimates.

sources.title: Thick points of log-correlated Gaussian fields do not depend on the mollifier
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: Ambrose reports almost-sure independence of thick-point sets from admissible mollifiers for log-correlated Gaussian fields, including a two-dimensional domain GFF extension.
sources.limits: Admissibility conditions and the distribution-valued field matter. This is not a dimension-uniform finite massive covariance-decay theorem or a Wilson-flow smoothing bound.

sources.title: Height fluctuation for Lozenge Tilings of Polygons
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: Huang proves Gaussian-free-field fluctuations for lozenge tilings of a specified class of simply connected polygons, using uniform inverse-Kasteleyn asymptotics.
sources.limits: Connected liquid region and non-forcing boundary assumptions are required. A massless GFF scaling limit cannot supply exponential decay for a massive finite Gaussian model.

sources.title: Uniform Partition-Function Estimates for Coulomb Modulated Energy at All Positive Temperatures
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: Wang and Zhao report particle-number-uniform partition-function bounds for centered Coulomb-type modulated energies in a locally square-integrable regime, with a second-chaos Fredholm-determinant limit.
sources.limits: Positive-real-parameter integrability does not establish complex zero-freeness. Particle-number uniformity is not automatically RG-scale, support or volume uniformity in the Yang-Mills activity norm. First posted 1 September.
